## Kyoto 5-Day Trip Overview

A balanced 5-day Kyoto plan for **2 adults** from **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-16**, built to stay within **¥180,000 total** excluding international flights.
Plan style: **moderate pace**, with temples, neighborhoods, food stops, and one lighter day for recovery.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Timeline

### Day 1 — 2025-10-12: Higashiyama Arrival + Old Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Morning: Arrive, check in, grab a simple lunch near Kyoto Station or Gion.
- Afternoon: Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Ninenzaka, Yasaka Pagoda area.
- Evening: Gion stroll, dinner in Pontocho or Gion.
- Pacing: **Moderate** — good first-day sightseeing without overloading after travel.

### Day 2 — 2025-10-13: Arashiyama + Western Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Morning: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Togetsukyo Bridge.
- Afternoon: Monkey Park Iwatayama or riverfront walk; optional boat ride if weather is good.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ea/Iwatayama_Monkey_Kyoto.jpg Alt=Afternoon: Monkey Park Iwatayama or riverfront walk; optional boat ride if weather is good, Kyoto, Japan
- Evening: Return to central Kyoto for a relaxed dinner.
- Pacing: **Moderate to active** — best day for walking and scenic time outdoors.

### Day 3 — 2025-10-14: Northern Kyoto Temples + Calm Neighborhoods
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Morning: Kinkaku-ji, then Ryoan-ji if you want a quieter temple stop.
- Afternoon: Daitoku-ji area or Kyoto Imperial Palace grounds.
- Evening: Casual izakaya or dessert stop in central Kyoto.
- Pacing: **Light to moderate** — temple-focused day with fewer transitions.

### Day 4 — 2025-10-15: Fushimi Inari + Southern Kyoto Food Focus
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Morning: Early Fushimi Inari Taisha hike to avoid crowds and heat.
- Afternoon: Fushimi sake district or Tofuku-ji area depending on energy.
- Evening: Nishiki Market area dinner and snack crawl.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Evening: Nishiki Market area dinner and snack crawl, Kyoto, Japan
- Pacing: **Active in the morning, easy later** — front-load the hike, keep the evening flexible.

### Day 5 — 2025-10-16: Central Kyoto Shopping + Departure Buffer
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Morning: Nishiki Market, Teramachi/Shinkyogoku shopping, or a final café stop.
- Afternoon: Pack, check out, and leave buffer time for airport transfer.
- Evening: Departure.
- Pacing: **Light** — keep this day intentionally loose for checkout and transit.

## Budget Breakdown and Route Grouping

| Area / Budget Line | Main Activities | Planned Cost (JPY) | Pace |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Higashiyama / Gion | Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Gion dinner | 28,000 | Moderate |
| Arashiyama / West Kyoto | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, bridge area, optional park/boat | 34,000 | Moderate to active |
| Northern Kyoto | Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, Imperial Palace area | 22,000 | Light to moderate |
| Fushimi / South Kyoto | Fushimi Inari, sake district, Nishiki evening | 24,000 | Active then easy |
| Central Kyoto / Departure | Market browsing, cafés, shopping, transit buffer | 16,000 | Light |
| Hotels, local transit, snacks, contingency | 4 nights stay, buses/subway, buffer for extras | 56,000 | Flexible |

## Budget Snapshot

- **Total planned spend:** **¥180,000**
- **Per day average:** **¥36,000**
- **Suggested split for 2 adults:**
  - Lodging: **¥72,000**
  - Food & drinks: **¥46,000**
  - Local transport: **¥12,000**
  - Entry fees: **¥18,000**
  - Shopping / extras / buffer: **¥32,000**

## Area-Based Kyoto Map Grouping

### Higashiyama & Gion
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- Best for: classic Kyoto streets, temples, evening atmosphere.
- Anchor stops: Kiyomizu-dera, Sannenzaka, Yasaka Shrine, Gion.
- Best time: late afternoon into evening.

### Arashiyama & Western Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- Best for: scenic nature, river views, relaxed walking.
- Anchor stops: Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji, Togetsukyo Bridge, Monkey Park.
- Best time: morning for softer light and fewer crowds.

### Northern Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- Best for: iconic temples and a quieter pace.
- Anchor stops: Kinkaku-ji, Ryoan-ji, Daitoku-ji, Imperial Palace area.
- Best time: morning to early afternoon.

### Fushimi & Southern Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- Best for: shrine hike, local food, sake culture.
- Anchor stops: Fushimi Inari Taisha, Fushimi sake district, Tofuku-ji.
- Best time: early morning for the shrine trails.

### Central Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- Best for: dining, shopping, transit convenience.
- Anchor stops: Nishiki Market, Teramachi, Shinkyogoku, Kyoto Station area.
- Best time: flexible, especially for meals and final-day logistics.
